research_leads.title: Ohio State Highway Patrol Flock network subscription approval
research_leads.issuer_stated_fact: Controlling Board request DPS0105268 lists approved waiver of competitive selection with $90,000 for FY2024 and $90,000 for FY2025 for a Flock Group subscription supporting unlimited users.
research_leads.what_remains_unknown: Approval does not prove invoices paid, term actually performed, real account enablement or additional camera installation. Original HTML response not retrieved by Katoptron's automated monitor.
research_leads.next_government_original: Executed vendor contract DPS020262, payment ledger and subsequent renewal decision; compare to request FY and actual delivery.

research_leads.title: Lafayette announces Flock suspension and removal process
research_leads.issuer_stated_fact: City statement says its 2027 budget removed Flock funding, it decided to end use, begin early termination and cover the 30 cameras under its city contract pending removal.
research_leads.what_remains_unknown: The announcement does not itself prove vendor-accepted termination, completion of every removal, or the status of non-city cameras. The old original Program webpage is still held.
research_leads.next_government_original: Signed termination and vendor acknowledgment, camera-removal completion receipts, and data deletion certification if available.

research_leads.title: Panama City Beach announces immediate Flock use suspension
research_leads.issuer_stated_fact: Police chief's September 1 statement says PCBPD suspended Flock ALPR use effective immediately and would coordinate camera removal with Flock.
research_leads.what_remains_unknown: Statement is not physical camera-removal proof or executed contract cancellation, and original article cannot yet be fetched automatically.
research_leads.next_government_original: Dated camera-removal completion memo, vendor cancellation and access deactivation report without individual plate data.

research_leads.title: Raleigh discloses ALPR monthly audits and 30-day data retention
research_leads.issuer_stated_fact: City's September 10 update states LPR use audits are conducted monthly and RPD's Flock data is deleted after 30 days unless preserved in an investigation.
research_leads.what_remains_unknown: City disclosure is not independent proof that every audit occurred or all purge processes operated as described.
research_leads.next_government_original: 2026 monthly aggregate audit completion reports, adopted policy version history, and retention control documentation.

research_leads.title: Hawaii DLE describes general ALPR retention and access controls
research_leads.issuer_stated_fact: DLE's official public ALPR page says retention is 90 days absent lawful preservation and search activity is logged for accountability.
research_leads.what_remains_unknown: The webpage is not dated; vendor, Flock manufacturer identity and the effective date of adopted policy are not established by this disclosure.
research_leads.next_government_original: Signed dated DLE ALPR policy, vendor contract, privacy impact assessment, and aggregate audit or retention-control results.

research_leads.title: Sheboygan police seeks Flock contract termination
research_leads.issuer_stated_fact: City's August 25 announcement says police leadership would ask the Common Council on September 8 to end Flock's contract and cover 15 city Flock cameras.
research_leads.what_remains_unknown: A proposed termination request does not establish council approval, executed cancellation, or eventual physical removal.
research_leads.next_government_original: September 8 council minutes and vote, signed contract termination, vendor acknowledgment, and camera-removal report.

research_leads.title: Liberty Hill announces Flock termination vote and city-camera removal
research_leads.issuer_stated_fact: City's September 17 release says council voted 7-0 on September 9 to end city Flock use and that city staff removed city-program cameras September 15.
research_leads.what_remains_unknown: The city announcement is not an independently audited removal inventory; privately operated or other-agency equipment lies outside the city's action.
research_leads.next_government_original: Adopted council action, executed vendor notice, and municipal camera-removal completion records.

research_leads.title: Fort Wayne chief announces decision to discontinue Flock
research_leads.issuer_stated_fact: Chief's August 31 statement says the city decided to discontinue its Flock program following a council contract vote and early federal grant closeout authorization.
research_leads.what_remains_unknown: Statement does not provide the executed vendor termination agreement, actual access cutoff date or independently verified camera-removal dates.
research_leads.next_government_original: Grant closeout approval, signed contract cancellation, implementation or equipment removal receipts.

notes: All claims explicitly scoped to source issuer statements and cited government URLs; external web-based inspection does not satisfy the automated original URL SHA-256 monitor. Never create a Watch event solely from this dataset.
